explore.eyebrow: A field guide to more outside
explore.heading: Explore the Outdoors
explore.intro: Small ideas for meaningful time outside. Start where you are, with the people you love.
explore.camping_copy: Start with an easy-to-reach campsite. Check the site’s facilities and current rules before you go. Practise pitching your shelter at home, make a packing list and leave enough daylight to settle in.
explore.family_copy: Keep the first trip simple. Let everyone choose one small activity, pack familiar comforts and leave space in the day for unplanned discoveries. A short, happy weekend is a good beginning.
explore.gear_copy: Choose for the trip you’re actually taking. Compare the product’s listed dimensions, packed size and care information. Check what is included, and ask us when details need confirming.
explore.setup_copy: Think in three spaces: sleeping, cooking and relaxing. Follow campsite guidance for where each belongs. Keep paths clear, organise essentials where everyone can find them and pack out what you bring in.
explore.stories_copy: Make a small record of your own time outside: a sketch of the view, a favourite meal, or a moment you want to remember. The best part of a weekend is often the story you take home.

about.heading: More time outside. More time together.
about.copy: A change of scenery can change the rhythm of a day. There is room to slow down, share a meal and notice the world around us.
about.values: Adventure, family and nature shape our direction. We’re here for thoughtful camping experiences and the memories that grow from them.
